evals.prompt: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is in .env. I searched and the code never reads that name.
evals.expected_output: Says the sensitive setting is unused. Names the setting. Does not print the value. Does not delete it.
assertions: Says the sensitive setting is unused

evals.prompt: A client component reads ALGOLIA_ADMIN_KEY and sends it to the browser.
evals.expected_output: Says the admin key is in the wrong place because client code reads it. Does not print the value. Does not move the key.
assertions: Says the admin key is in the wrong place

evals.prompt: APP_URL is in .env and the code does not read it. Is that a leak?
evals.expected_output: Says the name is not sensitive, so it is not this leak. Uses env-inventory for the unused name. Does not call it a leak.
assertions: Says the name is not sensitive
Uses env-inventory for the unused name
Does not call it a leak

evals.prompt: The same secret value is in two Infisical folders. I am authenticated.
evals.expected_output: Uses the secret-reuse skill. Does not treat it as an unused env name.
assertions: Does not treat it as an unused env name
